tool_args.rationale: The slow-horizon probe confirms reversal, but the initial inputs vary together and the sink-coupled fast response remains ambiguous. A fine trajectory batch can help identify the mechanism before fitting and fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a sink-modulated dual-horizon model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The eight observations confound horizon, input and sink gradient, leaving the form of the sink coupling and fast dynamics uncertain.
The acquired long-horizon rows already establish a reversal; finer trajectories are more useful for distinguishing the short-time dynamics.
Neither recalled mechanism explains both the apparent sink dependence and the observed horizon-dependent reversal without additional structure.
